title: Studio in Kyiv
description: A modern, sunlit studio apartment located in the heart of Kyiv on Khreshchatyk Street, perfect for professionals seeking convenience and comfort. The apartment features a contemporary designer interior with high-quality finishes. The compact yet functional kitchen comes fully equipped with essential appliances. The living space is bright and inviting, with ample natural light throughout the day. This new property is pet-friendly and provides a cozy urban retreat in a central location.

Ideal for students or young professionals, this room offers a quiet and comfortable space. The apartment has shared amenities and is conveniently close to educational institutions and local amenities. The room is unfurnished for flexibility and the property is not pet-friendly, providing a calm environment for focused living.

Pet-friendly, this property balances city convenience with serene riverside surroundings, ideal for enjoying Odesa’s lifestyle

The property is pet-friendly, offering ample room for children and pets to enjoy. With a mix of traditional and modern touches, this home provides a welcoming suburban lifestyle.
